key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) Internal Complaints Committee (ICC)

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Complaints involving sexual harassment of female students or employees, including those with disabilities, must be handled primarily by the Internal Complaints Committee established under the POSH Act of 2013 and institutional safety guidelines. The ICC possesses statutory jurisdiction to inquire into sexual harassment allegations, ensuring confidential, sensitive, and legal redressal.

questions.question_english: According to the statutory rules and standard operating procedures (SOPs) framed under the RPwD Act, 2016, what is the maximum time frame generally stipulated for a Grievance Redressal Officer to inquire into and resolve a complaint filed by an employee with a disability?
options_english: 7 days
15 days
30 days
90 days
questions.explanation_english: Under Section 23 of the Rights of Persons with Disabilities (RPwD) Act, 2016 and Rule 10 of the RPwD Rules, 2017, read with administrative instructions and SOPs issued by the Department of Personnel and Training (DoPT) and the Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (DEPwD), the Grievance Redressal Officer (GRO) must inquire into the complaint and take up the matter with the head of the establishment for corrective action. The standard time frame established under these statutory procedures for resolving an employee's disability-related grievance or submitting an inquiry report is a maximum of thirty (30) days from the date of receipt of the complaint. If the grievance is not resolved within this period, or if the employee is aggrieved by the decision, the complainant is entitled to approach the District-Level Committee on Disability or the State/Chief Commissioner for Persons with Disabilities.

questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english: A parent of a child admitted under the Economically Weaker Section (EWS) quota in a private unaided recognized school submits a written complaint to the Principal, stating that the school is demanding fees for textbooks and uniform contrary to RTE rules. What is the legally correct and mandatory response of the Principal?
options_english: Reject the complaint stating books and uniforms are never free in private schools
Provide books and uniforms free, seeking reimbursement from the State
Advise the parent to transfer the child to a state school if unable to pay costs
Forward the complaint to the local police department for extortion inquiry
questions.explanation_english: Under Section 12(1)(c) and Section 12(2) of the Right of Children to Free and Compulsory Education (RTE) Act, 2009, private unaided recognized schools admitting children under the 25% EWS and Disadvantaged Group (DG) quota must provide free and compulsory elementary education. High Courts across the country, notably the Delhi High Court in landmark rulings (such as 'Justice for All v. Govt. of NCT of Delhi' and 'Federation of Public Schools v. GNCTD'), have conclusively held that 'free education' is not restricted merely to tuition fees. It includes the mandatory provision of free textbooks, writing materials, and school uniforms, as financial barriers in purchasing these essential materials prevent underprivileged children from participating equally in school. The school is legally prohibited from charging any money from the parents for these entitlements; instead, the school management must supply them free of cost and seek per-child statutory reimbursement from the State Government under Section 12(2).
questions.explanation_hindi: निःशुल्क और अनिवार्य बाल शिक्षा का अधिकार (RTE) अधिनियम, 2009 की धारा 12(1)(c) के तहत गैर-सहायता प्राप्त निजी विद्यालयों में 25% EWS/DG कोटे के बच्चों को 'निःशुल्क और अनिवार्य शिक्षा' प्रदान करने का कानूनी दायित्व है। दिल्ली उच्च न्यायालय सहित विभिन्न उच्च न्यायालयों ने अपने ऐतिहासिक निर्णयों (उदा. जस्टिस फॉर ऑल बनाम एनसीटी दिल्ली सरकार) में यह स्पष्ट रूप से स्थापित किया है कि 'निःशुल्क शिक्षा' का अर्थ केवल ट्यूशन फीस माफ करना नहीं है, बल्कि इसमें पाठ्यपुस्तकें, लेखन सामग्री तथा विद्यालयी गणवेश (यूनिफॉर्म) भी अनिवार्य रूप से निःशुल्क उपलब्ध कराना शामिल है। विद्यालय प्रबंधन किसी भी स्थिति में इन मदों के लिए अभिभावकों से शुल्क नहीं वसूल सकता। विद्यालय का कानूनी दायित्व है कि वह छात्र को ये सभी सामग्रियां निःशुल्क प्रदान करे और तत्पश्चात धारा 12(2) के तहत राज्य सरकार से इनकी प्रतिपूर्ति (Reimbursement) प्राप्त करे। अतः विकल्प B सही उत्तर है।
